newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-McGrath to return home because of foot injury.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-McGrath to return home because of foot injury.

text.p: Australia fast bowler Glenn McGrath will miss the upcoming limited overs series against South Africa after succumbing to a nagging foot injury.
Queensland fast bowler Adam Dale will be sent to South Africa as a replacement for the seven-match series over the coming three weeks.
Western Australia wicketkeeper Adam Gilchrist will join Dale on the plane to South Africa as cover for Ian Healy, who was suspended from the first two one-day internationals for dissent.
Both Gilchrist and Dale will be available at the conclusion of the Sheffield Shield final in Perth later today.
McGrath will return home later this week.
Vice-captain Healy was banned after being found guilty of dissent during the third and final test, won convincingly by South Africa at Centurion Park in Pretoria on Monday.
Healy glowered angrily with hand on hip at umpire Cyril Mitchley after the decision was made and stamped from the field before throwing his bat through the dressing-room door.
He will miss the matches in East London on Friday and Port Elizabeth on Monday.
